trace_contract.default: Disabled unless explicitly supplied by the owner; construction is inert.
trace_contract.ordering: Sequence is local to the trace runtime. Equal timestamps do not imply order; client/Worker/authority clocks do not define a global total order.
trace_contract.clock: Injected now function, default Date.now. Failed or nonfinite reading becomes null and increments clockFailures.
trace_contract.metadata: Allowlisted finite scalar counts/labels only. Identifier labels contain at most 160 ASCII alphanumeric or _ . : / - characters. Payloads, errors, URLs, headers and credentials are never inspected by the trace helper. Host-selected identifiers must not contain private data.
trace_contract.immutability: The safe record and copied metadata are frozen; recorder reads return a frozen copy.

recorder.overflow: Replace oldest, increment dropped; no unbounded queue.

trace_contract.failure_isolation: Sink/clock/custom host identity failures do not become application errors. Recursive trace emissions are dropped without queueing. Deliberate external mutations or slow synchronous sink work are outside observational guarantees.
trace_contract.lifecycle: scope.dispose observes cancellation initiation; actual release is proved separately by teardown/resource checks. effect.cancel is distinct from complete and error and does not imply rollback.
trace_contract.execution: Tracing absent returns the identical source. Enabled trace wraps the already owned subscription inline; reading the recorder activates no effect.

evidence_boundaries.workerd_integration: Actual local workerd and attached SQLite; independently constructed functional authority/Hono/client owners may use trusted in-process diagnostic correlation. This does not add production HTTP headers, public RPC fields or assert remote routing.
evidence_boundaries.browser: Actual native client HTTP/EventSource and client trace observations are separate from the trusted local Hono/authority bridge.
evidence_boundaries.time: Sequence orders records within the producing trace runtime. Clock readings may be equal; timestamps from browser, Worker and authority do not create a global total order.
evidence_boundaries.cleanup: Trace notifications alone do not prove release. Direct listener/source/transport/queue checks establish resource ownership.
evidence_boundaries.cancellation: Local cancellation is not rollback. A committed operation can be reconstructed even if its HTTP response was lost.
evidence_boundaries.performance: Lightweight recorded local elapsed/resource measurements only; no universal speed or general glitch-freedom claim.
